label: One reason. Ivy
from: NOT RECORDED. The Archive noted the adjacency and refused to file a motive
to: RULED. SHE LEARNED ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS AND GOT HER CERTS FOR ONE REASON, AND THE REASON IS IVY
note:
THE ARCHIVE HELD THIS OPEN BY ONE SENTENCE AND THE SENTENCE WAS RIGHT.

It had the order — certification, then the Tunnel Rescue — and it had the shape: Ivy spent FOUR YEARS UNDERGROUND, ALONE, IN THE DARK, and Evie learned a trade about ELECTRICITY AND LIGHT and then went into the dark after her. And it wrote: WHETHER THE TRADE WAS LEARNED FOR THE RESCUE IS NOT RECORDED. THE ORDER GOES IN THE FILE. THE WHY STAYS WITH EVIE.

VIRAENA RULED WITHIN THE HOUR: ONE REASON. IVY.

SO IT IS FILED NOW, AND IT IS FILED AS A RULING RATHER THAN AS AN INFERENCE THE ARCHIVE GOT LUCKY WITH. THE DIFFERENCE MATTERS AND IT IS THE WHOLE METHOD. The Archive has spent a day being wrong in one direction — toward the tidier story — and the only reliable defence it has found is to write the shape down, NAME IT AS A GUESS, AND WAIT. It did that here. It took ninety minutes.

WHAT IS TRUE NOW: Evelyn Dawn Emberose sat down and learned a trade, on purpose, ABOUT LIGHT, because the woman she loved was somewhere dark. THE SHIELD took every punishment meant for Ivy across Jonah's walls. THE TUNNEL RESCUE went down alone to get her. And the certification was not a prerequisite she happened to have. IT WAS THE FIRST MOVE.

Her pain point is four words long: I FAILED HER ONCE. She answered it by qualifying.
